messages.text:
update from the call with Vince — it's more concerning than I thought. their head of ops has been demoing a competitor and Vince found out from a contact, not from the customer directly. so the relationship has some gaps. few things stood out:
• they feel like they're not getting proactive value, just reactive support
• the ERP integration gap is a real blocker for one of their core workflows
• Vince hasn't had exec contact in over 4 months

I think we need to escalate this one. they're strategic enough that losing them would hurt and we have enough lead time to do something about it if we move now

yeah that changes things. if a competitor is already in there actively demoing, we're behind. I think we need Amy involved — even just an exec outreach email to their VP to reestablish the relationship. it signals that we're paying attention at the right level. Elliot can you bring this to her?

on the product side — I can put together a short brief on the ERP roadmap and where the integration lands. if there's anything we can pull forward or offer as a beta access I'd rather know now than after they've made a decision

yes — Carlos please do that, helpful to have something concrete if Amy reaches out and they ask about it. Erin I'll bring it to Amy tomorrow. I want to go in with a clear ask: exec outreach from her, a recovery EBR within 3 weeks, and a short-term product commitment on the integration or a clear timeline. Vince will lead the ground game but we need to show up differently at the top

makes sense. for what it's worth — Associate Supply has been a customer for 3 years, they've never churned a seat. if we can get in front of this I think the relationship is salvageable. let's just move fast
